summary: Raises core Tier-I regulatory capital with a coupon rate of 7.75% and 5-year call option.

blocks.text: 🪝 SBI Issues ₹4,691 Crore Basel III-Compliant AT-1 Perpetual Bonds. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Raises core Tier-I regulatory capital with a coupon rate of 7.75% and 5-year call option.
Issuance Details: ₹4,691 crore raised via Basel III Additional Tier 1 (AT1 (additional tier 1 perpetual loss-absorbing bonds)) perpetual bonds at 7.75% coupon.
Loss Absorbency: AT1 (additional tier 1 perpetual loss-absorbing bonds) bonds feature loss absorbency (can be written off or converted to equity during stress).
AT1 (additional tier 1 perpetual loss-absorbing bonds) bond call option window (after 5 years) vs perpetual maturity.
